pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: Often heavily battle scared from use, this +2 greater resilient chain mail is commonly issued to frontline soldiers who are tasked with battling through enemies to reach high-value targets across…
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
Often heavily battle scared from use, this *+2 greater resilient chain mail* is commonly issued to frontline soldiers who are tasked with battling through enemies to reach high-value targets across the battlefield.

**Activate–Quick Spike** ↺ (manipulate, metal)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** A creature within 15 feet uses a manipulate action

**Effect** An iron spike launches from your armor at the target, dealing 7d8 piercing damage to the target (DC 36 basic Reflex save). If the target critically fails, the triggering action is disrupted.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Robe of Beneficence
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: This soft, buttery smooth robe is +2 greater resilient explorer's clothing made from silk and unicorn hair.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
This soft, buttery smooth robe is +2 greater resilient explorer's clothing made from silk and unicorn hair. The back and shoulders are appliquéd with clusters of angel feathers to form a motif of unfurled wings. On this robe are subtle arabesques, loops, and curlicues that are pleasing to the eye and evoke a sense of calm. When you wear this robe, you gain an invisible aura of purity and kindness that extends from you in a 30-foot emanation, granting you a +3 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make An Impression and to make Requests of creatures who are within your aura.

**Activate—Compelled Nonviolence** ◆◆ (concentrate, incapacitation, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The wings of this robe extend, and your aura glows golden, briefly becoming visible as it does. Creatures within your aura who are hostile, indifferent, or unfriendly to you must attempt a DC 36 Will saving throw with the following effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Stunned 1.

**Failure** The creature is Stunned 2.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature can't use any hostile action against you for 1 round.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Robe of Beneficence

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Energy Shield Tunic (Greater)
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: This sleek, color-changing tunic has a higher thread count than most garments.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
This sleek, color-changing tunic has a higher thread count than most garments. It's a *+2 greater resilient explorer's clothing* that helps the wearer survive powerful energy magic. During your daily preparations, you choose one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 15 to the chosen energy type until your next daily preparations. The tunic changes color and gains thematic embroidery to reflect the energy type you've chosen.

- **Acid** The tunic turns brown and has acid splashes embroidered in bright green thread.
- **Cold** The tunic turns sky blue and has snowflakes embroidered in silver thread.
- **Electricity** The tunic turns dark gray and has lightning bolts embroidered in light blue thread.
- **Fire** The tunic turns orange and has balls of fire embroidered in red and yellow threads.
- **Sonic** The tunic turns white and has musical notes embroidered in golden thread.

Effect: Energy Shield Tunic

**Activate—Shielding Command** ↺ (fortune, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against a spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, but you haven't rolled yet

**Effect** Roll the triggering saving throw twice and take the better result.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Energy Shield Tunic (Greater)

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Linnorm's Sankeit
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: Though the helm is shaped like the beast's head, a linnorm's actual head would be too large for a proper helmet.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
Though the helm is shaped like the beast's head, a linnorm's actual head would be too large for a proper helmet.

**Activate** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You breathe a 60-foot cone of electrified vapor, dealing 17d6 electricity to creatures in the area (DC 38 basic Reflex). The electrified mist persists in the area for 2 rounds, dealing 5d6 electricity (DC 38 basic Reflex save) to each creature that ends its turn in the mist. If you slew the linnorm this armor is made from, you can use the higher of your class DC or spell DC instead of the listed DCs for this effect.

**Activate** ↺ (manipulate)

**Trigger** A creature adjacent to you targets you with a melee attack

**Effect** The creature takes 4d6 piercing as previously invisible magical spines leap outwards from the armor to punish them for the attack.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the hide and skull of a taiga linnorm.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Blade Byrnie (Major)
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: Instead of chain links, this +3 greater resilient chain shirt is assembled from metal "leaves" that each resemble a small blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
Instead of chain links, this *+3 greater resilient chain shirt* is assembled from metal "leaves" that each resemble a small blade.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Effect** You pull a link from the armor, which transforms into a *+3 greater striking dagger*. The dagger disappears and reappears as a link in the armor after you Strike with it, or at the end of this turn if you don't make a Strike. You can Activate the *blade byrnie* in place of an Interact action to draw a weapon for abilities such as the Quick Draw feat.

Effect: Blade Byrnie

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Cloister Robe (Major)
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: The most devoted, cloistered clerics wear a cloister robe.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
The most devoted, cloistered clerics wear a *cloister robe*. Decorations symbolic of a specific deity adorn the robe, and the robe's colors and the complexity of its construction fit the deity's outlook. The robe serves as a religious symbol of that deity, and it doesn't need to be wielded to provide that benefit.

The robe is *+3 greater resilient explorer's clothing* and grants a +2 item bonus to Religion checks. The robe doesn't grant any benefits to a wearer who doesn't worship the deity tied to the robe. In addition, when you cast a domain spell from one of the deity's domains, you gain resistance to damage from divine spells until the end of your next turn. This resistance is equal to half the robe's level.

Effect: Cloister Robe

**Activate—Domain Devotion** ◇ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a cleric domain spell for a domain belonging to the deity the vestments are dedicated to. If you don't spend this point by the end of this turn, it is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a cleric who worships the deity tied to the robe.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Juggernaut Plate
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: When you are wearing this armor, you're a veritable battering ram.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
When you are wearing this armor, you're a veritable battering ram. This *+3 greater resilient fortification full plate* is topped with a reinforced helmet shaped like a ram's head that enables you to smash through doors and gates.

**Activate—Ram** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You Stride up to 60 feet in a straight line. If you end your movement adjacent to an enemy, object, or structure, you can smash it. If you smash an enemy, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to the total distance traveled (DC 39 basic Fortitude save). Objects and structures you smash take damage equal to twice the distance traveled.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Library Robes (True)
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: These +3 greater resilient scroll robes magically store a spell for you.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description: These *+3 greater resilient scroll robes* magically store a spell for you. During your daily preparations, choose one spell you know of 9th rank or lower. You inscribe that spell on the robes, as though you had done so using the robes' inscribed trait, but without needing to go through the normal scribing process. You must provide the minimum amount of materials to Craft one scroll of that spell (typically half the Price of a scroll of that level plus any extra cost required for the spell). You don't need to be trained in Crafting, nor do you need the Magical Crafting feat. Using this ability erases any scroll already inscribed on the robe.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Ouroboros Buckles
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: Its form and abilities were inspired by ouroboros, embodiments of eternity that continually consume and regenerate their bodies and appear to be formed from masses of snakes.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
Its form and abilities were inspired by ouroboros, embodiments of eternity that continually consume and regenerate their bodies and appear to be formed from masses of snakes. *Ouroboros buckles* have the comfort trait. However, while wearing *ouroboros buckles*, the unfathomable concept of infinity pulls at your mind, and each time you awaken, you'd swear the armor hissed into your ear while you were asleep. The hissing suggested secret wisdom to you in Aklo, though you only ever remember it vaguely, like a fading dream.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You call forth the cursed regenerative blood of an ouroboros to recover from your wounds. You gain regeneration 15 for 1 minute; fire damage deactivates this regeneration. Each time you regain Hit Points from this regeneration, if you're in your normal form, you collapse into a Large swarm of Tiny snakes. This is a polymorph effect that changes you into a battle form.

When you're a swarm of snakes, you gain low-light vision, imprecise scent (30 feet), a Speed of 20 feet, a climb Speed of 20 feet, and a swim Speed of 20 feet. You have an AC of 16 + your level and ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction. Also, you gain resistance 5 to physical damage and weakness 5 to area damage and splash damage. You can use none of your normal Strikes. Instead, you can use Swarming Bites, a single action that deals 4d4 piercing plus 2d6 poison damage to creatures in your space with a DC 41 basic Reflex save.

If you're in this battle form and are already at full HP when your regeneration occurs, the snakes instantaneously slither together, and you transform into your original form.

Effect: Ouroboros Buckles

Effect: Ouroboros Buckles (Swarm of Snakes)

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** A foe within 15 feet hits you with a Strike that deals slashing or piercing damage

**Effect** Your *ouroboros buckles* spray acidic blood in a 15-foot cone toward the foe, dealing 5d6 acid damage with a DC 41 basic Reflex save.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Breastplate of the Mountain
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: Constructed of dull gray metal, this breastplate is decorated with the symbol of a craggy black mountaintop.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
Constructed of dull gray metal, this breastplate is decorated with the symbol of a craggy black mountaintop. This breastplate functions as a *+3 greater resilient breastplate*. When you're Shoved or otherwise forced to move, you can reduce the amount you move by up to 10 feet. When you invest the breastplate, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You pound a solid and constant rhythm on your breastplate and cast a 7th-rank Regeneration spell on yourself.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** With a single tap, you gain immunity to poison for 1 minute.

Effect: Breastplate of the Mountain

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You fail or critically fail a Fortitude saving throw

**Effect** If you failed the saving throw, it becomes a success. If you critically failed, it becomes a failure instead.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Equipment: Breastplate of the Mountain

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Immortal Bastion
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: This impressive +3 greater resilient greater fortification bastion plate is built like an impregnable castle, with multiple layers of defense and no weak points.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
This impressive *+3 greater resilient greater fortification bastion plate* is built like an impregnable castle, with multiple layers of defense and no weak points. When you activate the armor's deflect melee trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against melee attacks instead of +1, and you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of your next turn.

Effect: Immortal Bastion

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You are reduced to 0 Hit Points or would die from a death effect

**Effect** You drop to 1 Hit Point instead of being reduced to 0 HP or dying, and you gain 100 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of your next turn.

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would gain or increase the doomed or wounded condition

**Effect** You avoid gaining or increasing the condition. If the triggering effect imposes both doomed and wounded, choose only one to prevent. This doesn't remove either of the conditions if you already have them, nor does it prevent the same triggering effect from giving or increasing the prevented condition later.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Incendiary Plate
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: This bright-red +3 greater resilient full plate is adorned with eerily beautiful, angry flames that flow and glow with your movement, making it appear as if you are engulfed in a living fire.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
This bright-red *+3 greater resilient full plate* is adorned with eerily beautiful, angry flames that flow and glow with your movement, making it appear as if you are engulfed in a living fire. You gain resistance 10 to fire while wearing this armor.

**Activate—Living Flame** ◆◆ (aura, concentrate, fire)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The armor engulfs you in a vortex of living fire in a 15-foot emanation for 10 minutes. Creatures that enter this aura or start their turn within it take 10d6 fire damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save). This area is difficult terrain for other creatures.

pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.name: Rebounding Breastplate
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.summary: This +3 greater resilient greater fortification breastplate absorbs impacts for later release.
pf2e-orc.equipment.armor.description:
This +3 greater resilient greater fortification breastplate absorbs impacts for later release. While wearing the armor, you gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and resistance 10 to force damage. Keep track of how much damage the armor prevents from enemy attacks, as the armor absorbs that damage. After 1 minute, the absorbed damage disperses harmlessly and resets to 0. Only damage caused by foes or hazards powers the armor, not damage you take from yourself, allies, or the environment.

**Activate—Kinetic Pulse** ◆ (force, manipulate)

**Requirements** Your armor has absorbed at least 30 untyped damage

**Effect** The absorbed energy explodes from your armor in a pulse of force. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation take 12d6 force damage with a DC 43 basic Fortitude save. On a failure, they're also pushed 10 feet away from you; on a critical failure, they're instead pushed 20 feet away from you and fall prone. The armor's absorbed damage resets to 0.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Caster's Targe
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This small shield is made from wood.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This small shield is made from wood. It features a special panel of parchment along the inside surface that allows for writing.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Dart Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This wooden shield features a spring-loaded device on its surface that can fire darts with powerful force.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This wooden shield features a spring-loaded device on its surface that can fire darts with powerful force. A small mechanism within the shield allows you to fire a dart even while actively holding the shield or blocking with it.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Gauntlet Buckler
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This buckler-sized shield is segmented, allowing it to collapse into a housing bound to a gauntlet for easy storage.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This buckler-sized shield is segmented, allowing it to collapse into a housing bound to a gauntlet for easy storage. A small catch enables you to expand the shield quickly in battle when you're in need of defense.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Harnessed Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This large steel shield features a specialized opening to hold lances and similar weapons.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This large steel shield features a specialized opening to hold lances and similar weapons. Harnessed shields are a common backup for those who fight with jousting weapons in case they're forced into combat without their mounts. Balancing the weapon within the shield's hold is somewhat awkward, and longer weapons, like lances, need to be held closer to the body than usual for proper support.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Heavy Rondache
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Similar in size to a buckler, this steel shield is intended to absorb as many blows as possible instead of deflecting attacks.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: Similar in size to a buckler, this steel shield is intended to absorb as many blows as possible instead of deflecting attacks. It features multiple layers of metal and is reinforced with additional wood.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Hide Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Hide shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: Hide shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Specialized tanning techniques combined with tough hides from creatures such as owlbears result in these particularly tough shields. The hardened hide of the shield still has enough flexibility to diminish the impact of battering and pummeling attacks.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Klar
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: The lightweight shield allows for quick attacks with its integrated blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: The lightweight shield allows for quick attacks with its integrated blade.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Meteor Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Meteor shields are specifically designed with throwing in mind.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: Meteor shields are specifically designed with throwing in mind. A meteor shield is made from thin steel and has quick-release straps, allowing for easy, long-distance throws.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Razor Disc
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Several small blades line the outside edge of this steel shield.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: Several small blades line the outside edge of this steel shield.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Salvo Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This specialized steel shield features an outer layer of angled wooden or steel plates, which help deflect or redirect incoming ranged projectiles but don't offer any additional protection against…
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This specialized steel shield features an outer layer of angled wooden or steel plates, which help deflect or redirect incoming ranged projectiles but don't offer any additional protection against melee weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Swordstealer Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This specialized steel shield features several wide metal hooks along its surface.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This specialized steel shield features several wide metal hooks along its surface. These hooks help catch swords and other blades, reducing the impact of their incoming attacks.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Fortress Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Also known as portable walls, these thick and heavy shields are slightly larger than tower shields.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
Also known as portable walls, these thick and heavy shields are slightly larger than tower shields. Like tower shields, they're typically made from wood reinforced with metal, but many are made from larger amounts of metal or even stone.

Getting the higher bonus for this shield requires using the Take Cover action while the shield is raised.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Bivouac Targe
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This buckler (Hardness 3, HP 6, BT 3) has the appearance of a common wooden shield.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This buckler (Hardness 3, HP 6, BT 3) has the appearance of a common wooden shield.

**Activate—Deploy Encampment** 1 minute (manipulate, structure) You pull a strap near the shield's enarmes to create a makeshift shelter that unfolds over the next minute. The shield becomes a pup tent until you spend another minute collapsing it. Within the tent is a satchel that holds 1 Bulk of Rations and replenishes every week.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sapling Shield (Minor)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 3, HP 24, and BT 12) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 3, HP 24, and BT 12) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling. The sapling withers as the shield takes damage.

**Activate** ◆ (concentrate)

**Effect** The buckler expands, with the sapling image growing into a mighty oak tree. The buckler becomes a tower shield, gaining the corresponding AC bonus, Speed penalty, and ability to Take Cover. It keeps the same Hit Points and Broken Threshold, but its Hardness and Bulk increase by 2 in this form. The shield remains in this form until you Activate it again to revert it to a buckler.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Siege Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This massive tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) is crafted from the toughest steel.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This massive tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) is crafted from the toughest steel. It's not ideal for single combat, but it can be used to defend soldiers during a siege. While this shield is raised, you gain resistance to damage from siege weapons equal to half this shield's Hardness.

**Activate—Plant Cover** ◆ (manipulate)

**Effect** You unequip the shield and prop it on the ground. The shield grants standard cover for one Medium or smaller creature in its square and lesser cover for a Large one.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Archer's Bulwark
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This embossed steel buckler (Hardness 4, HP 12, BT 6) is designed to not interfere with the hand an archer uses to pull back their bowstring.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: This embossed steel buckler (Hardness 4, HP 12, BT 6) is designed to not interfere with the hand an archer uses to pull back their bowstring. When you Raise a Shield with this buckler, the circumstance bonus to AC it grants against ranged Strikes increases to +2. This increased bonus doesn't apply to unusually massive ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Burr Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This well-crafted wooden shield (Hardness 5, HP 30, BT 15) is covered in numerous seed pods with long spurs.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This well-crafted wooden shield (Hardness 5, HP 30, BT 15) is covered in numerous seed pods with long spurs. You can Strike with these burrs as though they were *+1 Striking Shield Spikes*.

**Activate—Prickly Sticker** ◆ (manipulate)

**Requirements** Your previous action was a successful Strike with the burrs

**Effect** One of the burrs catches on the Strike's target, inflicting 1d10 persistent bleed damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Helmsman's Recourse
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This standard-grade duskwood meteor shield (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is a wheel from a ship.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This standard-grade duskwood meteor shield (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is a wheel from a ship. While wielding the shield, you gain a +1 item bonus to Sailing Lore and to Athletics checks to Swim.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're in a body of water

**Effect** For 10 minutes, you don't sink if you haven't succeeded at a Swim action on a turn, and if you're submerged, you automatically ascend 10 feet at the end of your turn.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Magnetic Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Copper rings spiral around this Steel Shield.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
Copper rings spiral around this Steel Shield. Twin electrical probes near the grip can socket into a jar of moderate (or higher leveled) Bottled Lightning, which takes 3 Interact actions to install.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Requirements** A *bottled lightning* is installed in the shield

**Effect** The shield becomes an electromagnet for 3 rounds. When an activated magnetic shield is raised, the circumstance bonus increases by 1 against attacks made with weapons primarily made of metal. If you use a Shield Block against a creature attacking you with such a weapon, you also gain a +1 item bonus to Disarm attempts against that weapon until the end of your next turn. The activation uses up the *bottled lightning*, and the shield can't be activated again until a new one is installed.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Shield of Silent Words
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: The surface of this steel buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) has been brushed into soft swirling patterns that evoke snowstorms.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description: The surface of this steel buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) has been brushed into soft swirling patterns that evoke snowstorms. While you have this shield raised, if you attempt to Cast a Spell or perform an action that has the auditory trait while you're deafened, reduce the DC of the flat check by 2.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Shield of Silent Words

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Testudo Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) sports a bright red front with a gold inlay of an eagle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) sports a bright red front with a gold inlay of an eagle. While it looks unassuming, this shield can protect not only yourself but also those behind you.

**Activate—Tortoise Form** ◆◆ (concentrate, force, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Your shield creates a magical barrier, consisting of translucent copies of the shield. The wall is 1 inch thick, 15 feet long, and 10 feet high. The barrier is conjured adjacent to you in a straight line on the border between squares and lasts for 1 minute. The barrier is created with the Hardness and Hit Points equal to those of the testudo shield and is immune to critical hits and precision damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Tiger Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: It's painted with bold, bright colors in the style of a fiendish tiger head.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
It's painted with bold, bright colors in the style of a fiendish tiger head. In combat, the eyes of the tiger seem to follow the opponent.

**Activate—Tiger's Eyes** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** Your shield is raised

**Effect** The tiger's eyes glow and animate. The shield casts Ill Omen (DC 20) on a target within your melee range.

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of ill omen.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Coward's Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This eerie, blackened steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) seems to actively reject light that touches it.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This eerie, blackened steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) seems to actively reject light that touches it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide while this shield is raised.

**Activate—Shadow Slip** ◇ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would take damage while this shield is raised

**Effect** Shadows swallow you. You become concealed until the end of your next turn.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Emergency Escape Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This curved steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) is painted with a large blue eye with a figure eight-shaped pupil.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This curved steel shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) is painted with a large blue eye with a figure eight-shaped pupil.

**Activate—Desperate Flight** ◇ (concentrate, teleportation)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You use the emergency escape shield to Shield Block, and the shield becomes broken

**Effect** You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space that you can see within 20 feet.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Emergency Escape Shield

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sapling Shield (Lesser)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 48, and BT 24) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 48, and BT 24) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling. The sapling withers as the shield takes damage.

**Activate** ◆ (concentrate)

**Effect** The buckler expands, with the sapling image growing into a mighty oak tree. The buckler becomes a tower shield, gaining the corresponding AC bonus, Speed penalty, and ability to Take Cover. It keeps the same Hit Points and Broken Threshold, but its Hardness and Bulk increase by 2 in this form. The shield remains in this form until you Activate it again to revert it to a buckler.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Energized Shield (Lesser)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is lined with pale silver that glows when struck.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is lined with pale silver that glows when struck. Whenever you use the Shield Block reaction, this shield becomes energized for 1 round.

**Activate—Energized Blast** ◆ (force, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Requirements** The shield is energized

**Effect** You direct the stored energy into a short blast, targeting a creature within 15 feet. The target takes 2d10 force damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save).

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Helmsman's Recourse (Greater)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Shield throw 30 ft.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
Shield throw 30 ft.

This standard-grade duskwood meteor shield (Hardness 8, HP 60, BT 30) is a wheel from a ship. While wielding the shield, you gain a +1 item bonus to Sailing Lore and to Athletics checks to Swim.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're in a body of water

**Effect** For 10 minutes, you don't sink if you haven't succeeded at a Swim action on a turn, and if you're submerged, you automatically ascend 10 feet at the end of your turn. When you Activate the shield, it casts Water Walk on you.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Staff-Storing Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This magically reinforced wooden shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) normally has a blank face.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This magically reinforced wooden shield (Hardness 6, HP 36, BT 18) normally has a blank face. It can absorb a staff and transform between a shield and staff. When you prepare a staff, you can hold it up to the shield, at which point the items merge until your next daily preparations, and the shield's face becomes an image corresponding to the type of magic, such as a skull for a *staff of the dead*.

**Activate—Astonishing Transfiguration** ◆ (manipulate)

**Effect** You change the staff-storing shield from its shield form into the stored staff, which has an image of the shield on it, or change it from the stored staff back into a shield. Reinforcing runes etched on the shield have no effect in the staff form, and fundamental weapon runes etched on the stored staff have no effect in the shield form.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Verdant Buckler
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This large wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is alive with creeping vines and mossy growths that shift in the air almost imperceptibly.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This large wooden buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is alive with creeping vines and mossy growths that shift in the air almost imperceptibly.

**Activate—Grasping Vines** ◇ (concentrate, plant)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You use the verdant buckler to Shield Block a melee Strike

**Effect** The attacking creature must succeed at a DC 24 Reflex save or be grabbed by the shield's animated vines (restrained on a critical failure). The affected creature is grappled or restrained for 1 round, until it Escapes, or you move, whichever comes first.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: War Mage's Buckler
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This minor reinforced buckler (Hardness 6, HP 50, BT 25) is a lightweight metal disk with a rounded bump at the center.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This minor reinforced buckler (Hardness 6, HP 50, BT 25) is a lightweight metal disk with a rounded bump at the center. The shield gives off a light hum near magic.

**Activate—Spell Amp** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You throw your shield up to 30 feet into an unoccupied space you can see. The shield magically floats in the space as a focal point for your magic for 1 minute. You can cast spells using the shield as your point of origin, calculating range and cover from its space instead of yours. You can Dismiss this effect, causing the shield to fly back to your hand. If the shield breaks, the effect ends.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sanguine Klar
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This +1 striking wounding klar (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is built with spikes made of beasts' fangs.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This *+1 striking wounding klar* (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is built with spikes made of beasts' fangs.

**Activate** ◇ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** You or a creature within 5 feet of you suffers bleed damage

**Effect** The sanguine klar regains a number of Hit Points equal to the bleed damage, up to an amount equal to its Hardness.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sapling Shield (Moderate)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 8, HP 64, and BT 32) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 8, HP 64, and BT 32) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling. The sapling withers as the shield takes damage.

**Activate** ◆ (concentrate)

**Effect** The buckler expands, with the sapling image growing into a mighty oak tree. The buckler becomes a tower shield, gaining the corresponding AC bonus, Speed penalty, and ability to Take Cover. It keeps the same Hit Points and Broken Threshold, but its Hardness and Bulk increase by 2 in this form. The shield remains in this form until you Activate it again to revert it to a buckler.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Shield of Endurance
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 32, BT 16) is engraved with the image of an unbroken fortress wall.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 32, BT 16) is engraved with the image of an unbroken fortress wall.

**Activate—Temporary Endurance** ◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** Your shield isn't broken

**Effect** You Raise the Shield, and it gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Shield of Endurance

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Shield of the Bear
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This massive steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 32, BT 16) is engraved with the image of a roaring face of a bear and lined with patches of bear fur.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This massive steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 32, BT 16) is engraved with the image of a roaring face of a bear and lined with patches of bear fur. When you have this shield raised, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you're moved 5 fewer feet.

**Activate—Feral Roar** ◇ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** You use the shield of the bear to Shield Block a melee Strike

**Effect** The attacking creature must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from you (15 feet on a critical failure).
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Shield of the Bear

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Turnabout Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: The face of this standard-grade silver salvo shield (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is polished to a mirror finish.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
The face of this standard-grade silver salvo shield (Hardness 7, HP 28, BT 14) is polished to a mirror finish.

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** A ranged Strike using ammunition such as arrows, bolts, or bullets (but not siege rounds or larger projectiles) misses you

**Requirements** You have the turnabout shield raised

**Effect** The ammunition enters the shield and is redirected with the same force with which it was originally fired. Make a ranged Strike using the ammunition with an attack modifier of +19, targeting a creature within 60 feet.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Warding Escutcheon
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: An image of a keyhole adorns the coat of arms of this stone tower shield (Hardness 10, HP 40, BT 20).
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
An image of a keyhole adorns the coat of arms of this stone tower shield (Hardness 10, HP 40, BT 20).

**Activate** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The shield becomes a locked door in an empty, adjacent space no wider than 5 feet, becoming flush with the surrounding structure so it blocks all passage. The door has the same Hardness, HP, and Broken Threshold as the shield, with DC 25 Athletics and DC 25 Thievery to open. The door remains in place for 1 hour, until it's opened or broken, or until you spend an action to end this effect, at which point the shield returns to your hand (or falls to the ground in your space if your hands are full).

**Activate** 1 minute (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The shield floats lazily in the air as bricks quickly fly from it to form a squat stone tower around it. You cast Cozy Cabin, with the shield becoming the door.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Hippopotamus Klar
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.traits: uncommon, integrated 1d6 s versatile p, invested, magical
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This +1 striking klar is fashioned from the skull of a hippopotamus, with one of its canines acting as the blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This *+1 striking klar* is fashioned from the skull of a hippopotamus, with one of its canines acting as the blade. While wielding a *hippopotamus klar*, you gain a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks.

**Activate—Engulfing Jaws** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The hippo jaws of the shield open impossibly wide. Make a melee Strike with the klar blade targeting two creatures adjacent to each other. Roll the attack and damage once and apply it to each creature separately. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the entire skull of a hippopotamus.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Howl of the Wild — Equipment: Hippopotamus Klar

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Shield of Mental Fortitude
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This small steel buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is engraved with an unbroken golden circle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This small steel buckler (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) is engraved with an unbroken golden circle. While you have this shield raised, you gain resistance 5 to mental damage.

**Activate—Mind Backlash** ↺ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You succeed at a Will save against a mental effect while the shield of mental fortitude is raised

**Effect** You return a wave of psychic energy to the creature. The creature that caused the triggering mental effect must succeed at a DC 27 Will save or become Stupefied 1 (Stupefied 2 on a critical failure).
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Shield of Mental Fortitude

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sun Slayer
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This lesser reinforced wooden shield (Hardness 6, HP 64, BT 32) is painted with intricate, pale-blue knots.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This lesser reinforced wooden shield (Hardness 6, HP 64, BT 32) is painted with intricate, pale-blue knots. The wood has been magically enhanced against solar energy and heat. While you have this shield raised, you gain fire resistance 5.

**Activate—Sunset** ◆ (darkness, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You are in sunlight

**Effect** You raise your shield in the air toward the sunlight, eclipsing it. The area in a 60-foot emanation becomes dim light for 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Clockwork Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This brass-coated, steel shield (Hardness 12, HP 90, BT 45) has +2 striking shield spikes made of bronze gears.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This brass-coated, steel shield (Hardness 12, HP 90, BT 45) has *+2 striking shield spikes* made of bronze gears.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The shield's gears begin to spin, subtly adjusting the shield's position as you fight. You gain an extra reaction this turn and at the start of each of your turns for the next minute that you can use only to Shield Block.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Energized Shield (Moderate)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is lined with pale silver that glows when struck.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This minor reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 64, BT 32) is lined with pale silver that glows when struck. Whenever you use the Shield Block reaction, this shield becomes energized for 1 round.

**Activate—Energized Blast** ◆ (force, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Requirements** The shield is energized

**Effect** You direct the stored energy into a short blast, targeting a creature within 15 feet. The target takes 3d10 force damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save).

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Helmsman's Recourse (Major)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: Shield throw 30 ft.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
Shield throw 30 ft.

This standard-grade duskwood meteor shield (Hardness 11, HP 80, BT 40) is a wheel from a ship. While wielding the shield, you gain a +2 item bonus to Sailing Lore and to Athletics checks to Swim.

**Activate** ◆◆ command

**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're in a body of water

**Effect** For 10 minutes, you don't sink if you haven't succeeded at a Swim action on a turn, and if you're submerged, you automatically ascend 10 feet at the end of your turn. When you Activate the shield, it casts Water Walk on you. and you can breathe underwater for 10 minutes.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Spellshock Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) is inlaid with jagged crystalline veins that hum with stored energy.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) is inlaid with jagged crystalline veins that hum with stored energy.

**Activate—Crackling Arc** ↺ (concentrate, electricity, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You succeed at a Reflex saving throw against a magical effect while the spellshock shield is raised

**Effect** A jagged bolt of unstable energy lashes out at a creature within 120 feet, dealing 4d12 electricity damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save).

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Stifling Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This matte black moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) seems to absorb sound, creating an eerie void around its wielder.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This matte black moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 10, HP 92, BT 46) seems to absorb sound, creating an eerie void around its wielder.

**Activate—Silence Falls** ↺ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** A creature within 15 feet of you Casts a Spell or takes an action with the auditory trait while you have the stifling shield raised

**Effect** The shield briefly dampens nearby sound. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 28 Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes a –1 status penalty to any check or DC related to the triggering action.

**Failure** As success, but the penalty is –2.

**Critical Failure** The action is disrupted.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Arctic Worm Chitin Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This tower shield is crafted from interlocking sections of an arctic cave worm's chitin that are rimed with constant frost.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This tower shield is crafted from interlocking sections of an arctic cave worm's chitin that are rimed with constant frost. It has Hardness 13, HP 104, and BT 52.

**Activate—Misty Chill** ◆ (cold, concentrate, manipulate)

**Effect** You Raise the Shield and an icy mist begins to flow off it. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain resistance 5 to cold and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 3d6 cold damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save).

Effect: Misty Chill

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include chitin from an arctic cave worm.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.cite: Howl of the Wild — Equipment: Arctic Worm Chitin Shield

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Resolute Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: The edges of this large tower shield (Hardness 12, HP 96, BT 48) are dented and worn, bearing the scuffs and marks of decades of battle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
The edges of this large tower shield (Hardness 12, HP 96, BT 48) are dented and worn, bearing the scuffs and marks of decades of battle.

**Activate—Stand Firm** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You have the resolute shield raised, and you would take physical damage from a critically successful attack

**Effect** The resolute shield prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to twice the shield's Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Sapling Shield (Greater)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This surprisingly weighty, though well-balanced, wooden buckler (Hardness 11, HP 88, and BT 44) is emblazoned with the image of a sapling.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Dragon Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 84, BT 42) has an image of a cinder dragon's head painted on it.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This moderate reinforcing steel shield (Hardness 8, HP 84, BT 42) has an image of a cinder dragon's head painted on it. Additional metal adornments accentuate the fearsome mouth.

**Activate—Burning Path** ◆◆◆ (fire, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You Raise your Shield and Stride up to twice your Speed in a straight line. You can move through creatures with this movement, but you can't end your movement in their space. Creatures you moved through take 5d8 fire damage (DC 31 basic Reflex save). Creatures who critically fail also take 1d8 persistent fire damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Testudo Shield (Greater)
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) sports a bright red front with a gold inlay of an eagle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This tower shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) sports a bright red front with a gold inlay of an eagle. While it looks unassuming, this shield can protect not only yourself but also those behind you.

**Activate—Tortoise Form** ◆◆ (concentrate, force, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Your shield creates a magical barrier, consisting of translucent copies of the shield. The wall is 1 inch thick, 25 feet long, and 10 feet high. The barrier is conjured adjacent to you in a straight line on the border between squares and lasts for 1 minute. The barrier is created with the Hardness and Hit Points equal to those of the testudo shield and is immune to critical hits and precision damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Vanguard's Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This moderate reinforced standard-grade duskwood tower shield (Hardness 8, HP 84, BT 42) is slightly wider than standard.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This moderate reinforced standard-grade duskwood tower shield (Hardness 8, HP 84, BT 42) is slightly wider than standard. Designed for bodyguards, it grants the user a small burst of speed to save themself and others from harm.

**Activate—By Your Side** ↺

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** An effect within 15 feet would deal damage in an area and require a saving throw

**Requirements** Your shield is raised

**Effect** You Stride up to 15 feet and grant yourself and creatures adjacent to you after the movement a +2 circumstance bonus to the saving throw against the triggering effect.

Effect: Vanguard's Shield

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.name: Medic's Shield
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This standard-grade dawnsilver shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) is inscribed with the symbol of a deity dedicated to healing and medicine.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This standard-grade dawnsilver shield (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10) is inscribed with the symbol of a deity dedicated to healing and medicine. The shield is designed for combat medics to aid combatants or adventurers in the midst of battle. Healer's tools can be stored on the backside of this shield. This shield grants a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

**Activate—Adrenaline Boost** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You grant a medicinal boost to bring someone back into the fray. You Administer First Aid to stabilize an adjacent ally with the dying condition. On a success, they gain 6d6+20 Hit Points, can immediately Stand as a free action, and become quickened for 1 round. They can use this extra action only to Stride or Strike.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This +2 greater striking wounding klar (Hardness 13, HP 100, BT 50) is built with spikes made of beasts' fangs.

pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.summary: This high-grade adamantine heavy rondache (Hardness 17, HP 100, BT 50) bears a +3 greater striking shield boss and has dents that resemble craters on its surface.
pf2e-orc.equipment.shields.description:
This high-grade adamantine heavy rondache (Hardness 17, HP 100, BT 50) bears a *+3 greater striking shield boss* and has dents that resemble craters on its surface. While wielding the shield, you have fire resistance 15.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You Stride up to three times. This movement doesn't trigger reactions and ignores difficult terrain. At the end of your movement, you deal 6d10 bludgeoning in a 10-foot emanation and 14d6 fire in a 40-foot emanation (DC 40 basic Reflex, with the results applying to both the bludgeoning and fire damage). The space where you end your movement and all adjacent spaces become difficult terrain for 1 minute, and the shield glows red-hot for 10 minutes, during which it gains the effect of the greater flaming property rune.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Bane
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A bane rune grants you improved understanding of creatures of a particular type, allowing you to deal more damage to those creatures.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A bane rune grants you improved understanding of creatures of a particular type, allowing you to deal more damage to those creatures. The crafter chooses aberration, animal, beast, celestial, construct, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, giant, monitor, ooze, or both fungus and plant. The weapon deals 1d6 additional damage of the weapon's damage type to creatures with the chosen trait or traits. The benefit doesn't apply against creatures of the chosen type disguised as other creatures. It's up to GM discretion whether the bane rune applies against a creature disguised as a creature of the chosen type.

The GM might allow bane runes for other creature traits, such as astral, demon, dream, or vampire. However, the humanoid trait, the undead trait, and the traits for specific types of humanoids (such as elf) are never a valid option.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Energy Vulnerability
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A weapon etched with this rune has a sheen of a color corresponding to the energy type chosen when the rune is created: green (acid), blue (cold), white (electricity), orange (fire), or yellow…
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A weapon etched with this rune has a sheen of a color corresponding to the energy type chosen when the rune is created: green (acid), blue (cold), white (electricity), orange (fire), or yellow (sonic). When you critically hit a target with a weapon with this rune, the target gains weakness 5 to the chosen energy type until the end of your next turn. This weakness isn't cumulative with any weakness to that energy type the target already has and doesn't affect a creature with immunity or resistance to that energy type.

Effect: Energy Vulnerability

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Merciful
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Merciful weapons are sheathed in an unmistakable wispy green aura recognized by both gladiators and guards around the world.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Merciful weapons are sheathed in an unmistakable wispy green aura recognized by both gladiators and guards around the world. A *merciful* weapon has the nonlethal trait and can't be used to make a lethal attack. Any persistent damage the weapon would deal is negated.

On a critical hit, a *merciful* weapon causes the target to become fascinated with the weapon's wielder for 1 minute, as the target is bombarded with feelings of guilt and remorse. This is a mental effect. If you have access to the weapon's critical specialization effect, you choose whether to use it or the *merciful* effect.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Assisting
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Your armor provides support for your joints or advanced prostheses for missing limbs, holding your body in place and easing physical symptoms.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Your armor provides support for your joints or advanced prostheses for missing limbs, holding your body in place and easing physical symptoms. This replicates the benefits of any number of splints, supports, and prostheses. When you invest the armor, you determine how many such supports you want, and where on your body they assist you.

In addition, the extra support and structure provided by the armor allows you to transport more than you would otherwise normally be able to. You can carry Bulk equal to 6 + your Strength modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk of up to 11 + your Strength modifier.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Convincing
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A convincing rune blends in with your armor's decorative elements, such as embossed patterns and colorful ornaments.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: A convincing rune blends in with your armor's decorative elements, such as embossed patterns and colorful ornaments. While wearing the armor, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make An Impression and Request.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Earthbinding
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A weapon with this rune hums when touched to the ground.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A weapon with this rune hums when touched to the ground.

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Requirements** You critically hit a flying creature with the etched weapon

**Effect** The rune casts a DC 20 Earthbind spell on the flying creature.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Mobile
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Armor etched with this rune lightens your feet.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: Armor etched with this rune lightens your feet. Once per turn, you can move an additional 5 feet when you Step.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Moonweave
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Your armor bathes your wounds in the cool light of the moon.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: Your armor bathes your wounds in the cool light of the moon. While wearing this armor, whenever you would be healed by a spell or magical effect, you recover an additional 2 Hit Points. You regain additional Hit Points from moonweave only the first time you regain HP from a given healing spell or effect, so a spell or effect that heals you repeatedly over a duration would restore additional Hit Points only once, when you're first healed.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Pacifying
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune turns weapons into instruments of peacemaking.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune turns weapons into instruments of peacemaking.

**Activate** ↺ (concentrate, mental)

**Trigger** You damage a creature with the etched weapon

**Effect** The damaged creature must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be pacified. A pacified creature takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls on any attacks that aren't nonlethal for 1 minute, and the creature also experiences a clear psychic warning that they should stop making attacks that could kill.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Aim-Aiding
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Armor etched with this rune aids in routing ranged attacks aimed at an enemy around you.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: Armor etched with this rune aids in routing ranged attacks aimed at an enemy around you. You don't provide enemies cover against your allies' ranged attacks.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Deflecting
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: When using a weapon etched with this rune to parry, you have the potential to reduce the damage you take.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
When using a weapon etched with this rune to parry, you have the potential to reduce the damage you take.

**Activate—Deflecting Parry** ↺

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're critically hit with a Strike that deals physical damage

**Requirements** You're benefiting from the bonus to AC from the weapon's parry trait

**Effect** You gain resistance 5 to physical damage against the triggering Strike.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Quenching
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune counters burning and corrosive agents.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: This rune counters burning and corrosive agents. Armor with this rune reduces the DC of the flat check to end persistent acid or fire damage affecting you from 15 to 12 (7 with particularly effective assistance).

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Swallow-Spike
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Your armor responds to your desire to break free of a creature grabbing you by growing spikes.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Your armor responds to your desire to break free of a creature grabbing you by growing spikes.

**Activate** ↺ (attack, concentrate)

**Trigger** You become grabbed, restrained, or otherwise held immobilized in a creature's grasp, such as by being engulfed or swallowed

**Effect** Your armor suddenly grows spikes, attacking the triggering creature. The armor makes a melee attack with an attack modifier of +14 that deals 2d6 piercing damage. If the creature is swallowing or engulfing you, the attack deals an additional 1d6 untyped damage, and damage from this attack can cut you free if it equals or exceeds the Rupture value of the immobilizing ability. This attack gets an item bonus to the attack roll equal to the armor's item bonus to your AC and an item bonus to damage equal to double that amount.

**Activate** ◆ (attack, concentrate)

**Requirements** You're being held immobilized as described in the rune's other activation

**Effect** Your armor attacks the creature immobilizing you. The armor makes a melee attack against the creature, as described in the rune's other activation.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Flurrying
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: When you make a Flurry of Blows using the etched weapon and your first Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, you can make your second Strike with an echo of the weapon, increasing the reach to…
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
When you make a Flurry of Blows using the etched weapon and your first Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, you can make your second Strike with an echo of the weapon, increasing the reach to 30 feet.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate, force)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The weapon casts a Spiritual Armament spell. The ghostly weapon looks like the etched weapon. Use your normal attack bonus and damage for the weapon instead of the damage listed in the spell, but use your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength when determining damage. You can choose to make a Flurry of Blows instead of a Strike when the *spiritual armament* attacks; this still counts as your flourish for the turn. You can Sustain this activation in the same manner as the spell.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Self-Sealing
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A suit of armor etched with this rune can create a bolstering magical layer that closes off to protect the wearer against dangerous environments.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: A suit of armor etched with this rune can create a bolstering magical layer that closes off to protect the wearer against dangerous environments. When you would take environmental damage, or when you enter an environment where you can't safely breathe, your self-sealing armor seals itself shut. It holds 1 minute's worth of air and grants you resistance 10 to environmental damage while sealed. You or another creature can take an Interact action to unseal it at any time. Once unsealed, the armor can't seal itself again for 1 hour.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Sunweave
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Your armor glows softly, granting you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Your armor glows softly, granting you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Activate—Glint of Ambition** ◇ (concentrate, fortune)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to attempt a Perception check for initiative

**Effect** You roll the check twice and take the better result.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Unnerving
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: The sound of weapons clanging against a suit of unnerving armor transforms into an inhuman screech that unsettles enemies and makes them hesitate to attack again.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: The sound of weapons clanging against a suit of unnerving armor transforms into an inhuman screech that unsettles enemies and makes them hesitate to attack again. Any creature that hits you with a melee Strike takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its next melee Strike that targets you before the end of your next turn.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A convincing rune blends in with your armor's decorative elements, such as embossed patterns and colorful ornaments.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: A convincing rune blends in with your armor's decorative elements, such as embossed patterns and colorful ornaments. While wearing the armor, you gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make An Impression and Request.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Gliding
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: The armor allows you to make a controlled descent.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
The armor allows you to make a controlled descent.

**Activate**◆ (concentrate)

**Effect** You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. Provided you spend at least 1 action gliding on your turn and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. Otherwise, you fall.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Advancing
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune charges up as you defeat your foes, driving you forward across the battlefield with every victory.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune charges up as you defeat your foes, driving you forward across the battlefield with every victory.

**Activate**◇ (concentrate)

**Requirements** Your last action or activity reduced an enemy to 0 Hit Points

**Effect** You Stride up to 15 feet. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Coating
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: When etched, this rune creates an extradimensional space that links to the weapon that wields it.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
When etched, this rune creates an extradimensional space that links to the weapon that wields it. The space can hold up to 1 Bulk but can contain only poisons and magic oils that could be applied to the weapon. Stowing or retrieving an item in the space requires an Interact action, except when using the rune's activation.

**Activate** ◆ (concentrate)

**Requirements** At least one magic oil or poison is stored inside the rune's extradimensional space

**Effect** For 1 minute, you can apply stored oils and poisons to the weapon without needing any hands free. Applying them takes the same number of actions as normal. An oil or poison applied this way pours directly from the extradimensional space onto the weapon, and when it's fully applied, its empty vial is ejected.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Portable
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This enables armor to collapse into a disguised, portable form.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This enables armor to collapse into a disguised, portable form.

**Activate**◆◆◆ (concentrate, manipulate)

**Effect** You doff your armor, which folds into another wearable object, such as a bangle or amulet with light Bulk. This wearable object has features that hint at the armor it hides. You aren't wearing the armor while it's in this form, but at the GM's discretion, you can still activate properties that might feasibly come from the wearable item the armor has become. If the armor is in its portable form, you can use this activation to revert it to armor, which you can don in 1 minute.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Swarming
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Able to copy itself many times over when thrown until the air is filled with deadly blades, a swarming weapon turns a single weapon into a shower of devastation.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Able to copy itself many times over when thrown until the air is filled with deadly blades, a swarming weapon turns a single weapon into a shower of devastation.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You fling your weapon and it multiplies as it flies through the air, filling a 30-foot cone. All creatures within the area take damage equal to double the weapon's number of damage dice, with a DC 27 basic Reflex save.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Impactful
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune thrums with pure magical energy.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: This rune thrums with pure magical energy. Weapons with the rune deal an additional 1d6 force damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, you can choose to force the target to succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or be pushed 5 feet away from you.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Magnetizing
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune alters the magnetic polarity of your armor, making other metal items drawn to it ever so slightly.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune alters the magnetic polarity of your armor, making other metal items drawn to it ever so slightly. You can amplify the magnetic power of the armor to keep another creature from getting away from you.

**Activate**◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Requirements** A creature adjacent to you is made of metal or wearing metal armor

**Effect** You magnetize your armor. If you or the target attempt to move away from one another, treat each square as difficult terrain. This doesn't affect movement that keeps you the same distance from one another, so you could still Step if you remained adjacent to the target. This effect ends once either of you is no longer adjacent to the other at the end of an action.

This Activation might work on some creatures partially made of metal, such as those with metal scales, as determined by the GM. Likewise, the GM might determine some metal creatures are non-magnetic, depending on the metal they're made of.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Quenching (Greater)
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune counters burning and corrosive agents.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: This rune counters burning and corrosive agents. Armor with this rune reduces the DC of the flat check to end persistent acid or fire damage affecting you from 15 to 10 (5 with particularly effective assistance).

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're about to attempt a Perception check for initiative

**Effect** You roll the check twice and take the better result.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Immovable
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune utilizes magical principles to manipulate gravity and turn you into an immovable object.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune utilizes magical principles to manipulate gravity and turn you into an immovable object.

**Activate**◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Your armor anchors you in place, even defying gravity, rendering you immobilized until you Dismiss the Activation. While you're immobilized in this way, you can be moved only if a creature succeeds at a DC 40 Athletics check to Force Open your armor. You can also be moved if 8,000 pounds of pressure are placed upon you, though this is likely fatal.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A complex pattern of protective symbols gives protection against various forms of energy, but only part of the runic structure can be active at a given time.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A complex pattern of protective symbols gives protection against various forms of energy, but only part of the runic structure can be active at a given time.

**Activate**↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

**Effect** You gain resistance 5 to the triggering damage type. This doesn't apply to the triggering damage. This resistance lasts until you Activate this rune again or the armor is no longer invested by you.

Effect: Energy Adaptive

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: Your armor bathes your wounds in the cool light of the moon. pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Safeguarding
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Your armor is overlayed with a shimmering mosaic of pink, turquoise, and blue energy that protects the most vital aspects of your person.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
Your armor is overlayed with a shimmering mosaic of pink, turquoise, and blue energy that protects the most vital aspects of your person. When activated, the armor's hue shifts according to the type of resistance you gain: turquoise (mental), blue (poison), or pink (spirit).

**Activate—Adaptive Aegis** ↺ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would take mental, poison, or spirit damage

**Effect** You gain resistance 5 to the triggering damage type that lasts for 10 minutes.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Sidestepping
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A suit of armor etched with this rune can cause its wearer's form to vibrate slightly out of phase with the rest of the world, allowing them to impossibly pass through solid objects.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A suit of armor etched with this rune can cause its wearer's form to vibrate slightly out of phase with the rest of the world, allowing them to impossibly pass through solid objects.

**Activate—Phase Through** ◆

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** Until the end of your current turn, you can move through non-magical solid surfaces. Treat any movement through an item thicker than air as difficult terrain. When the duration ends, if you're sharing space with a solid item, you'll be shoved into the closest unoccupied space and take 6d6 bludgeoning damage.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Spellwatch
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Counter-runes chip away at unwanted magic that impedes you.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description: Counter-runes chip away at unwanted magic that impedes you. You can attempt a new saving throw against one hostile spell affecting you at the start of each of your turns. If you succeed, the spell ends, and if you fail it continues unchanged, with no additional ill effect. If you're affected by multiple hostile spells, choose only one each turn to attempt the additional save against.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: A weapon etched with this rune has a sheen of a color corresponding to the energy type chosen when the rune is created: green (acid), blue (cold), white (electricity), orange (fire), or yellow…
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
A weapon etched with this rune has a sheen of a color corresponding to the energy type chosen when the rune is created: green (acid), blue (cold), white (electricity), orange (fire), or yellow (sonic). When you critically hit a target with a weapon with this rune, the target gains weakness 10 to the chosen energy type until the end of your next turn. This weakness isn't cumulative with any weakness to that energy type the target already has and doesn't affect a creature with immunity or resistance to that energy type.

Effect: Energy Vulnerability

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Misleading
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune attempts to obfuscate your location through illusory trickery.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune attempts to obfuscate your location through illusory trickery. When you're concealed, the DC of the flat check to target you with an effect is 6 instead of 5.

**Activate**◆◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** The armor casts mislead, affecting you. It lasts until the end of your next turn.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Impossible
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This rune makes a weapon capable of impossible offense and defense.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This rune makes a weapon capable of impossible offense and defense. The etched weapon is immune to Dispel Magic and similar effects that could counteract its magic. If it's a ranged weapon or thrown weapon, its range increment is doubled.

**Activate** ◆◆ (concentrate, teleportation)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You and the weapon flash to a perfect attacking position, then return to where you started. Make a Strike with the etched weapon against one creature you can see, even if the target is beyond the weapon's reach or range. On this Strike, ignore any circumstance penalty, status penalty, and range increment penalty.

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Mythic Armor Potency
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This armor is etched with a mythical ward providing unparalleled defense.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This armor is etched with a mythical ward providing unparalleled defense. Increase the armor's item bonus to AC by 4, and the armor can be etched with four property runes.

**Activate—Survive Devastation** ↺ (concentration)

**Trigger** An enemy critically succeeds against you with a weapon or unarmed Strike

**Effect** Spend a Mythic Point; if the triggering Strike was made by a mythic creature, it's a normal success instead. If it was made by a non-mythic creature, it's a failure.

**Craft Requirements** *Mythic armor potency* runes can only be crafted, etched, or transferred by a mythic character capable of making a Crafting check at mythic proficiency (such as by having the Artisan's Calling).
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: Mythic Armor Potency

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Mythic Resilient
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: Mythic resilient runes imbue armor with unrivaled protection from a wide array of effects.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
*Mythic resilient* runes imbue armor with unrivaled protection from a wide array of effects. The armor grants a +4 item bonus to saving throws to the wearer.

**Activate—Defy Obliteration** ↺ (concentration)

**Trigger** You critically fail a saving throw

**Effect** Spend a Mythic Point; if the triggering save was made due to an effect created by a mythic monster, hazard, or other effect, it's a normal failure instead. If the save was made due to an effect that wasn't mythic, it becomes a success.

**Craft Requirements** *Mythic resilient* runes can only be crafted, etched, or transferred by a mythic character capable of making a Crafting check at mythic proficiency (such as by having the Artisan's Calling).
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: Mythic Resilient

pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.name: Mythic Striking
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.summary: This weapon is filled with unmatched destructive power.
pf2e-orc.equipment.runes.description:
This weapon is filled with unmatched destructive power. The weapon deals five weapon damage dice.

**Activate—Unstoppable Devastation** ↺ (concentration)

**Trigger** You roll the weapon damage dice for a Strike with this weapon and do not like the result

**Effect** Spend a Mythic Point and reroll your weapon damage dice, taking the higher of the two results.
